analysis.executive_summary: Audit of docs.cryptoprocessing.com covered 78 pages with 100% crawl coverage and 91.5% overall confidence. Retrieval readiness scores 84.61/100 (strong band), with 82.21% API reference coverage across 28 detected API pages. Critical gaps: 0% example reliability estimate, 25% SEO/geo issue rate, 50% actionability coverage, and 61.7% evidence coverage (58 of 94 key claims lack supporting evidence). One confirmed broken internal link detected in user-facing docs.
strengths: 100% last-updated coverage and 100% answerability/citationability for AI retrieval
82.21% API reference coverage with 28 API pages detected, no detection limitations flagged
Strong overall retrieval readiness band (84.61/100) with 82.05% chunkability
Comprehensive crawl: 78 of 78 discovered pages indexed, zero trap URLs
High audit confidence at 91.5% overall, 95% for links and crawl
risks: 0% example reliability estimate indicates no validated or testable code examples across 78 pages, blocking developer onboarding
25% SEO/geo issue rate (approximately 20 pages) risks poor discoverability in search and regional access problems
61.7% evidence coverage means 36 of 94 key claims lack citations, reducing trust and AI answer accuracy
50% actionability coverage suggests half the content lacks clear next steps or CTAs, weakening conversion
1 confirmed broken internal link in user-facing docs damages navigation and user trust
17.79% API reference gap (approximately 5 missing API pages or endpoints) may leave critical integration paths undocumented
No stale risk detected but 0% example reliability could mask outdated code patterns not flagged by freshness checks

prioritized_actions.action: Instrument and validate all code examples with automated testing or runnable snippets to lift 0% example reliability
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Validated examples directly unblock developer onboarding and integration success, the highest-value conversion path for API docs.

prioritized_actions.action: Add evidence citations or links to 36 unsupported claims (38.3% gap) prioritizing API authentication, payment flows, and security assertions
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Evidence gaps on critical claims erode trust and degrade AI-generated answers, directly impacting support deflection and sales confidence.

prioritized_actions.action: Audit and resolve SEO/geo issues on ~20 pages (25% issue rate), focusing on meta descriptions, canonical tags, and regional access
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: SEO fixes improve organic discovery and regional reach, expanding top-of-funnel traffic with moderate effort.

prioritized_actions.action: Fix the 1 confirmed broken internal link and implement link-check CI to prevent future breakage
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Quick win that restores navigation integrity and prevents recurring trust erosion with minimal effort.

prioritized_actions.action: Enhance actionability on 39 pages (50% gap) by adding explicit next steps, CTAs, or related endpoint links after tutorials and guides
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Clear CTAs improve conversion from docs readers to active users, especially on high-traffic onboarding pages.

automation_first: Deploy CI-integrated example testing (e.g., doctest, runnable notebooks) to validate code snippets on every commit, addressing the 0% example reliability across all detected examples and preventing outdated code from reaching production docs.

Implement automated broken link scanning in pre-deploy pipeline to catch the 1 confirmed broken internal link type issue before publish, with Slack alerts for any new failures, reducing manual QA overhead and trust damage.

Add evidence-coverage linter to flag claims lacking citations during content review, targeting the 36 unsupported claims (38.3% gap) and ensuring new content meets evidence standards before merge, improving AI answer quality and reducing post-publish rework.
limitations: External audit cannot verify runtime correctness of code examples or API endpoint behavior; 0% reliability estimate reflects lack of test instrumentation, not execution validation.
SEO/geo issue detection covers technical signals (meta tags, structure) but cannot measure actual search ranking, click-through rates, or regional performance without analytics integration.
Evidence coverage identifies claims without citations but cannot assess the accuracy, relevance, or authority of provided sources.
API coverage detection relies on structural patterns; complex or non-standard API documentation may be undercounted despite 85% detection confidence.
Actionability and chunkability scores reflect content structure and formatting but cannot predict actual user task completion or comprehension outcomes.
